def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])

    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n

def bruteforce(n, m):
    even = []
    odd = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            if (i + j) % 2 == 0:
                even.append((i, j))
            else:
                odd.append((i, j))
    match = [[False] * len(odd) for _ in range(len(even))]
    for i, (ex, ey) in enumerate(even):
        for j, (ox, oy) in enumerate(odd):
            if abs(ex - ox) + abs(ey - oy) == 3:
                match[i][j] = True
    return 2 * max_matching(match)

def max_matching(graph):
    if not graph or not graph[0]:
        return 0
    n1 = len(graph)
    n2 = len(graph[0])
    matching = [-1] * n2
    matches = 0
    for u in range(n1):
        visited = [False] * n1
        if find_path(graph, u, matching, visited):
            matches += 1
    return matches

def find_path(graph, u1, matching, visited):
    visited[u1] = True
    for v in range(len(matching)):
        if graph[u1][v]:
            u2 = matching[v]
            if u2 == -1 or (not visited[u2] and find_path(graph, u2, matching, visited)):
                matching[v] = u1
                return True
    return False
